lines.beaver_en: Hello, Jisu. Did you pick a date for the gathering?
lines.en: Yes, Uncle. How about Saturday, May 10th?
lines.roman: ne, samchon. owol sibil toyoil eottaeyo?

lines.beaver: 그날 좋아. 식구가 몇 명이나 와?
lines.beaver_en: That day works. How many of your family are coming?
lines.beaver_roman: geunal joa. sikguga myeot myeongina wa?
lines.learner: 저희 부부랑 아이 둘, 네 명이에요.
lines.en: My husband and I and two kids, four people.
lines.roman: jeohui buburang ai dul, ne myeongieyo.

lines.beaver_en: The kids must have grown a lot. I miss them.
lines.en: Yes, the kids have grown a lot.

lines.beaver_en: Really? It's been ages since I saw my big brother.
lines.learner: 아버지가 손녀를 많이 보고 싶어 하세요.
lines.en: Dad really wants to see his granddaughter.
lines.roman: abeojiga sonnyeoreul mani bogo sipeo haseyo.

lines.beaver: 몇 시에 모여? 너희 엄마도 오시지?
lines.beaver_en: What time do we meet? Your mom is coming, right?
lines.beaver_roman: myeot sie moyeo? neohui eommado osiji?
lines.en: At 12. Mom and my younger brother are coming too.

lines.beaver_en: Is your brother's wife coming too?
lines.en: Yes, his wife and my nephew are coming too.

lines.beaver_en: So we're going with Saturday, right?
lines.en: Yes, Auntie's family is busy on Sunday.

lines.beaver_en: Is it okay for Big Uncle's family?
lines.en: Yes, they said Saturday is good for them too.

lines.beaver_en: All the relatives will gather. Where is it?
lines.en: At Grandma's house. All the cousins are coming too.

lines.beaver_en: Great. Saturday, May 10th, I'll be there for sure.
lines.beaver_roman: joa. owol sibil toyoil, kkok galge.
lines.en: Okay, Uncle. See you on Saturday!
